name: A Looming Shadow
notes: Secondary Researches (after Mercenary 4th Contract), IMPORTANT: For Mercenary builds, some upgrades (such as FR10 and UD10) are based on the highest amount of certain Unique Buildings this Reincarnation. It is important to run all required buff builds beforehand, pay attention to build notes! Buff Swarming Tower and Flesh Workshop counts (see builds below). Cycle Dragon’s Breath to Red,Green,Black,Yellow and ideally Blue as 5th. ### Max Flesh Workshops Purpose: Building target S425,C425 ### Max Swarming Towers Purpose: Building target Autocast Spiritual Surge on tier 3 until Djinn Treaty.

name: After MCC2
notes: A2950: Makers Secondary Researches (during Druid Chaos Madness): Buff spells cast, Combo Strike activity time, and Flesh Workshops count. Run the build multiple times. More gems is ideal for better results, the range is a minimum. Import secondary researches during Druid Chaos Madness, then wait for Fairy Chaos Madness for maximum assistants. You can check [Realm Weather Service](https://shadowgull.github.io/dox4242.github.io/rws/index.html) to see when Druid CM is coming up.
author: Weedheter

name: Alternative (quick) Max Excavations
notes: A2950: Undead Doesn’t require buffing assistants, should outperform the above build unless you have high faceless set (e14+). Buff Flesh Workshops; get offline time and alignment times, Combo Strike activity time (offline as ddudan when buffing evil/order, drowline for other alignments). Wait for Druid Chaos Madness to afford all the research. S5875 requires ~12h spent as Good/Chaos, replace with S5125 if you can’t afford it. Dragon’s Breath on Red,Green,Black,Yellow. After setup run for a few mins, then wait for Titan Chaos Madness and buy max excavations. Should reach ~70k excavations.
